tools.name: route
tools.description:
Selects a live paid API endpoint matching buyer spending and readiness rules, and returns routing evidence. Does not buy the seller's service. Seller payment is separate; the agent keeps the wallet.

Use for fresh probing and constraint-based selection, or signed binding evidence before merchant sig

tools.name: preview
tools.description: Discovers catalog-listed paid API endpoints by capability without paying or contacting sellers. Returns claimed listings and any earlier observations; not_probed=true means this is not a new live check. Freshness is for this search response, not each seller's last probe. Results can be limited or no

tools.name: validate
tools.description:
Checks unpaid readiness for one concrete HTTPS seller URL already listed in the local catalog (for example a URL from preview). Compares claimed vs observed payment/readiness flags. Does not buy the service or append a routing observation to history.

Use for a free readiness check of a known catalo

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "route" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
